title: OneDrive: build and share agents from OneDrive files, with .agent files retiring after March 2027
summary: Hold: the inventory question treats OneDrive coverage in SharePoint Advanced Management agent reports as unknown, although Microsoft documents that coverage. The corrected blocking distinction, retirement dates and control endpoints are supported; the statement that no site owner can notice a OneDrive agent is unconfirmed.
